# Nigel Dickinson Photography

> > Documentary photography archive by Nigel Dickinson covering indigenous peoples, social movements, cultural traditions, and contemporary issues across Europe, Asia, and beyond.

Nigel Dickinson is a photojournalist whose work spans four decades, documenting indigenous communities in Borneo (Penan and Dayak peoples), social justice movements, conflict zones, environmental activism, and cultural events. His portfolio includes coverage of the Balkan wars, Charlie Hebdo aftermath, UK road protests, and innovative architecture like Tokyo's Pasona building.

## Key Topics

- Documentary photojournalism
- Indigenous peoples (Penan, Dayak)
- Sarawak Borneo rainforest
- Social movements and activism
- Charlie Hebdo / Je Suis Charlie
- Balkan wars and refugees
- Environmental protest movements
- Romany Gypsies culture
- Monumental sculpture (Sebastian)
- Urban farming and sustainable architecture
- COVID-19 pandemic documentation
- Cultural traditions and festivals
- Conflict photography
- Paris cultural events
- Tokyo contemporary architecture
